```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
```

```{r nav, results='asis'}
cat(deseq2reports::report_nav_links(
  params$current_page,
  disabled = params$disabled_labels,
  hrefs = params$page_hrefs
))
```

```{r qc-section, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$qc_out)) {
  cat("\n\n## Library QC\n\n")
  cat("\n\nGenes removed at each QC step:\n\n")
  steps_df <- params$qc_out$steps_summary
  steps_df$pct_removed <- paste0(formatC(steps_df$pct_removed, format = "f", digits = 2), "%")
  print(knitr::kable(steps_df,
                      col.names = c("Step", "Genes before", "Genes removed", "% removed", "Genes after"),
                      row.names = FALSE))

  filter_method <- params$qc_out$filter_method
  if (is.null(filter_method)) {
    cat("\n\nLow-expression filter: **none applied** (`filter_method = NULL`). ",
        "Enable one with `filter_method = \"cpm\"` (percentile-based) or ",
        "`filter_method = \"count\"` (per-group absolute threshold) in `run_qc()` ",
        "(or `run_deseq2_pipeline()`).\n\n", sep = "")
  } else if (identical(filter_method, "cpm")) {
    cat("\n\nLow-expression filter: removed the bottom **",
        round(params$qc_out$cpm_percentile * 100, 2),
        "%** of genes by mean CPM across samples. ",
        "Adjust via the `cpm_percentile` argument to `run_qc()` ",
        "(or `run_deseq2_pipeline()`).\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat("\n\nLow-expression filter: keep a gene if, in at least one group, \u2265 **",
        params$qc_out$min_samples_per_group, "** sample(s) have a raw count \u2265 **",
        params$qc_out$min_count, "**. Adjust via the `min_count`/`min_samples_per_group` ",
        "arguments to `run_qc()` (or `run_deseq2_pipeline()`); switch to the percentile-based ",
        "filter with `filter_method = \"cpm\"`.\n\n",
        sep = "")
  }

  deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce library QC with this package module:",
    "dds_qc <- run_qc(dds, var = \"condition\", filter_method = \"cpm\")"
  )

  cat("\n\n### Count distribution\n\n")
  cat("\n\nDistribution of the per-gene filtering statistic before and after low-expression removal, ",
      "overlaid on the same axes. The dashed line marks the expression cutoff.\n\n")
}
```

```{r qc-count-dist-plot, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$qc_out)}
deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(params$qc_out$count_dist_plot, filename = "count_distribution_plot",
                                       width = 3, height = 2.5, dpi = 150)
```

```{r qc-libsize-heading, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$qc_out)}
cat("\n\n### Library size\n\n")
```

```{r qc-libsize-plot, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$qc_out)}
n_samp <- if (!is.null(params$qc_out$n_samples)) params$qc_out$n_samples else params$n_samples
lib_w <- max(2.5, 2 + 0.15 * n_samp)
deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(params$qc_out$library_size_plot, filename = "library_size_plot",
                                       width = lib_w, height = 2.5, dpi = 150)
```

## Sample QC

```{r sample-qc-methods, results='asis'}
deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
  caption = "Reproduce sample QC (PCA + similarity) with this package module:",
  "distance_out <- run_distance_pca(dds_qc, var = \"condition\")"
)
```

### PCA {.tabset}

```{r pca-has-batch, include=FALSE}
pca_has_batch <- !is.null(params$distance_out$pca_plot_uncorrected_interactive)
```

#### After batch correction

```{r pca-after-heading, results='asis'}
if (pca_has_batch) {
  cat("\n\nHover over a point to see its sample name. PCA/scree/loadings below are all ",
      "computed on the batch-corrected matrix; batch correction is for visualization only ",
      "and does not alter the DESeq2 design or differential expression results.\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo batch correction was applied (`batch = NULL`); this is simply the PCA on the ",
      "variance-stabilized matrix. See the \"Before batch correction\" tab for the identical data.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r pca-after-plot, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$distance_out$pca_plot)) {
  btn <- deseq2reports::download_plot_button(params$distance_out$pca_plot, filename = "pca_plot", width = 4.4, height = 3.75)
  deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(params$distance_out$pca_plot_interactive, btn, center = TRUE)
}
```

### Sample similarity (Spearman)

Pairwise Spearman correlation between samples in variance-stabilized expression
space (colour scale spans the actual min/max off-diagonal correlation observed
in this dataset; darker red = more similar, darker blue = less similar). The
self-correlation diagonal carries no information and is blanked out (dark grey).

```{r dist-heatmap, results='asis'}
gt <- params$distance_out$similarity_plot$gtable
native_w <- grid::convertWidth(sum(gt$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
native_h <- grid::convertHeight(sum(gt$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
# Keep current width; height slightly shorter than width (~90%).
side_in <- 0.8 * max(native_w, native_h)
disp_w <- side_in * 0.4
disp_h <- disp_w * 0.9
dpi <- 220
pixelratio <- dpi / 72
css_w <- as.integer(round(native_w * 72))
css_h <- as.integer(round(native_h * 72))
display_w <- as.integer(round(disp_w * dpi))
display_h <- as.integer(round(disp_h * dpi))
img_tag <- htmltools::plotTag({
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(gt)
}, alt = "sample_similarity_heatmap", width = css_w, height = css_h, pixelratio = pixelratio,
   suppressSize = "xy",
   attribs = list(
     width = display_w, height = display_h,
     style = sprintf("max-width: none !important; width: %dpx; height: %dpx;", display_w, display_h)
   ))

buttons <- list(
  deseq2reports::download_grid_plot_button(params$distance_out$similarity_plot, filename = "sample_similarity_heatmap",
                                           width = native_w, height = native_h)
)
if (!is.null(params$distance_out$similarity_matrix)) {
  buttons <- c(buttons, list(deseq2reports::download_table_button(as.data.frame(params$distance_out$similarity_matrix), filename = "sample_similarity_matrix")))
}
deseq2reports::emit_widget(deseq2reports::wrap_with_corner_button(img_tag, buttons))
```
